classes.description: Second-generation oral antipsychotics: aripiprazole, quetiapine IR/ER, olanzapine, risperidone, ziprasidone, lurasidone (Latuda), paliperidone ER, cariprazine (Vraylar), brexpiprazole (Rexulti), lumateperone (Caplyta), asenapine, iloperidone, clozapine, olanzapine/samidorphan (Lybalvi).

records.verificationNote: Read PDL pp.18-19 (Antipsychotics - Second Generation) by rendered page image. Preferred column: risperidone tablet/solution, clozapine, asenapine, lurasidone, olanzapine tablet/ODT, paliperidone ER, quetiapine, quetiapine ER, aripiprazole tablet, Vraylar, ziprasidone. Risperidone picked as the lowest-barrier preferred generic with no printed strength or F/Q/D limit; quetiapine is the other common pick but carries F/Q/D limits. Non-preferred brands listed in paRequired are a sample; full list on pp.18-19. Non-preferred = PA per PDL intro (p.1). Strength not printed on PDL.

records.verificationNote: Read PA/DO/QL flags for antipsychotic rows on pages 33-34; rendered-image check of page 12 confirmed the text rows align with their tier and flags. Every second-generation oral antipsychotic on the list carries PA, so the preferred pick is the lowest-barrier Tier 1 PA product (risperidone). Haloperidol is also Tier 1 PA but is first-generation. Quetiapine 150 mg is the only Tier 1 quetiapine strength. Page 2 states the list is complete. Quantity limits are QL flags without printed numbers; no ST flags in this class. [Sonnet check 2026-10-22: Re-read pages 33-34 by column position: risperidone, aripiprazole, quetiapine, olanzapine, ziprasidone, lurasidone, paliperidone, asenapine, clozapine, and the first-generation agents all print PA in the Notes column, with QL or DO. Unusual for a commercial list but it is what is printed. Risperidone Tier 1 is the lowest tier. Page 2 reads "Is this a complete listing of all covered drugs? Yes, this is a complete listing of all the drugs on the drug list", so absence from the list is recorded as not on the list; page 3 says a prescriber can still request a coverage review.]
